observations: The opening prediction asks for XOR fold of seven integers without defining XOR before the choice.
First fold changed zero to five; first duplicate three returned running value six to five, visibly toggling lamps two and one back.
Original order finished at seven; New order automatically ran a different ordering and also finished at seven, retaining both sequences.
Reveal explains identical-pair cancellation, identity zero, order independence and failure when another number appears an odd number of times.
